_role_note: RUNTIME CONFIG, not the plugin manifest. The code reads this file's `config` block via findPluginJson() (config.ts). The Claude Code plugin MANIFEST is .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name: 'contextus' — the marketplace install id). Two files on purpose: this is the tunable runtime config, that is the install descriptor. Keep `version` in sync with the manifest.
name: contextus
description: Context-aware knowledge system with automatic semantic retrieval
author: Anthony Dawson

embedding._provider_note: DESIGN.md default is 'transformers' (in-process ONNX). Deployed as 'ollama' because the corporate Cloudflare Gateway blocks Hugging Face model downloads — Ollama runs the same nomic model locally over localhost. Both emit 768-dim. See BUILD_LOG Phase 1.
embedding._transformers_note: Used when provider='transformers'. To run on an HF-blocked network: `pnpm fetch-model --out ./models` on an unblocked machine, then set localModelPath to that dir. Or set remoteHost to an internal HF mirror. allowRemoteModels:false forces strict offline.

retrieval._similarityThreshold_note: UNVALIDATED ranking filter (applied after re-rank, not the gate) — calibrate in Phase 5.
retrieval._injectionFloor_note: Gate on raw similarity — 'inject anything at all?'. SEPARATE from similarityThreshold. Calibrated to 0.45 in Phase 6 via `/context-calibrate --floor --apply` against the chunked 54-file / 721-chunk corpus (replay of ~300 real prompts → ~31% injection, the ~35% coverage target). #1↔#2 separation is weak (0.020), so no absolute floor cleanly separates signal from noise — this is a cold-start value; refine with a usage-eval campaign (`/context-calibrate --start`). The v2 top-K/relative-separation gate supersedes absolute floors.

expansion._note: Multi-vector query expansion: generate alternate phrasings when the initial search scores poorly. Dramatically improves synonym/paraphrase recall. adaptive=expand only below threshold, always=every query, off=disabled.

calibration._note: Quality evaluation (LOGGING.md calibration_eval). targetSamples=evaluations per campaign before auto-disable. model judges whether injected patterns were USED (anthropic Haiku default — proven reliable, ~10x cheaper than Sonnet; ollama is the privacy/offline opt-in). The MUTABLE campaign state (live counter, enabled flip) lives in ~/.contextus/calibration-state.json, NOT here.

notifications._verbosity_note: SessionStart daemon-state messages (user-facing systemMessage). silent=never | normal=fresh spawn/warming/failure only | verbose=also heartbeat with uptime when an existing daemon is found. Override per-session with CONTEXTUS_VERBOSITY env.

logging._paranoid_note: Logs full prompt text + complete injection payload to ~/.contextus/logs/paranoid.jsonl. OFF by default (privacy). View with: contextus watch --paranoid
